dedupe_keys.name: multilayer graph model of the internet topology ip router pop as and isp layers 2012 snapshot

description: This Zenodo dataset gives an integrated snapshot of the internet topology for 2012 with graph models at five layers: IP interfaces, routers, points of presence (PoP), autonomous systems (AS) and internet service providers (ISP). It was built by integrating data from several public topology measurement sources, and it accompanies an article that aims to make the structural composition of the internet clearer for routing, security and resilience research. Coverage: the global internet as seen by the source measurements in 2012, at five layers with the links between layers. Format and access: one ZIP archive of graph files on Zenodo, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: a single 2012 snapshot, far older than today's topology; mapping between layers depends on inference methods with known errors (alias resolution, geolocation); the article was not read, so the exact inputs are not confirmed. Simulation uses: a multilayer network for cascading failure and resilience studies of the internet, for example how failures of PoPs propagate to AS connectivity. Related records: data-caida-internet-topology-data-kit and data-caida-as-relationships give current router-level and AS-level topology; data-internet-topology-zoo gives operator backbone graphs.
